QUOTE: "A missing optional grammar makes the route resolve to nothing instead of raising." and "The build-time not-indexed report ... names the file types that were in scope but not read."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a missing grammar degrades (no crash), the route is gated by a capability check (`_grammar_available`/`has_language`), and those file types are reported as not indexed.
